reason: NONE. What I noticed first was the price and 'no reviews yet', then the QR lab-report line; nice idea for the gym bag, but I already reorder my Pure Encapsulations and I don't see an NSF or USP seal, so a brand with zero reviews doesn't get my money.
objection: No reviews and no NSF or USP seal. A lab report on their own QR code isn't the same as a third-party certification I already trust, and $1 a day is more than my current bottle costs per serving.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP seal on the box plus a few hundred real verified reviews, or a cheap trial size I could try without risking $30.
